<title>Welcome to LWC Communities!</title>

<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part1.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part2.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part3.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part4.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />



<!-- branding stylesheets-->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/print.css }" media="print"/>
<script type='text/javascript'>
	var otChatReady = false;
	function initEmbeddedMessaging() {
		try {
			embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.language = 'ko';
			embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.devMode = true;
			embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.targetElement = document.body;
			embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.hideChatButtonOnLoad = true;

			embeddedservice_bootstrap.init(
				'00Dbm00000tKBue',
				'OT_Service_Chat',
				'https://trailsignup-8617b18a6871a9.my.site.com/ESWOTServiceChat1788276984308',
				{
					scrt2URL: 'https://trailsignup-8617b18a6871a9.my.salesforce-scrt.com'
				}
			);
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Error loading Embedded Messaging: ', err);
		}
	};
	function bootEmbeddedMessagingWhenReady() {
		if (document.body) {
			initEmbeddedMessaging();
		} else {
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initEmbeddedMessaging);
		}
	};
	window.addEventListener('onEmbeddedMessagingReady', function() { otChatReady = true; });
	// T5-23: 포털 LWC(otEquipDetail)는 Lightning Web Security로 격리돼
	// 있어 window.embeddedservice_bootstrap을 직접 호출할 수 없다(실측
	// 확인). 그래서 LWC는 document에 'ot_launch_chat' 커스텀 이벤트만
	// 쏘고, 이 최상위(LWS 밖) 스크립트가 그걸 받아 실제 SDK를 호출한다.
	// T5-23 (2026-08-31): 자산 컨텍스트 전달은 Head Markup의 fetch()가 아니라
	// LWC->Apex(@AuraEnabled) 표준 경로로 처리한다(otEquipDetail.js 참고) —
	// 여기서 raw fetch로 REST 엔드포인트를 직접 호출했더니 사이트 인증
	// 세션이 안 실려 401이 났음(실측 확인). 이 스크립트는 launchChat()만 담당.
	document.addEventListener('ot_launch_chat', function(e) {
		var evtAssetId = (e.detail && e.detail.assetId) || null;
		function tryLaunch() {
			if (window.embeddedservice_bootstrap && embeddedservice_bootstrap.utilAPI) {
				embeddedservice_bootstrap.utilAPI.launchChat();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
		function extractUidAndNotify(assetId, attempt) {
			try {
				var raw = localStorage.getItem('00Dbm00000tKBue_WEB_STORAGE');
				if (raw) {
					var data = JSON.parse(raw);
					var jwt = data && data.JWT;
					if (jwt) {
						var b64 = jwt.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/');
						var payload = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(b64))));
						var sub = payload && payload.sub;
						if (sub && sub.indexOf('uid:') !== -1) {
							var uid = sub.split('uid:')[1];
							console.log('[T5-23 HeadMarkup] uid extracted:', uid);
							document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ot_uid_ready', { detail: { uid: uid, assetId: assetId } }));
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			} catch (err) { console.error('[T5-23 HeadMarkup] uid extract error', err); }
			if (attempt < 8) { setTimeout(function(){ extractUidAndNotify(assetId, attempt+1); }, 600); }
			else { console.warn('[T5-23 HeadMarkup] uid not found after retries'); }
		}
		try {
			if (!otChatReady || !tryLaunch()) {
				setTimeout(tryLaunch, 1500);
			}
			if (evtAssetId) { setTimeout(function(){ extractUidAndNotify(evtAssetId, 0); }, 2000); }
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('OT chat launch error: ', err);
		}
	});
</script>
<script type='text/javascript' src='https://trailsignup-8617b18a6871a9.my.site.com/ESWOTServiceChat1788276984308/assets/js/bootstrap.min.js' onload='bootEmbeddedMessagingWhenReady()'></script>
<!-- T5-23 (2026-08-31): #embeddedMessagingFrame에 !important로 크기를
     강제했더니 채팅창이 닫혀있을 때도 빈 흰 박스가 계속 떠 있는 회귀가
     발생(실측) — MIAW가 열림/닫힘을 그 요소의 width/height 자체로
     토글하는 것으로 보임. 그래서 CSS 강제 대신 Branding 화면의 공식
     Chat Window Dimensions 설정으로 대체하고 이 커스텀 CSS는 제거함. -->
<style>
	/* ── 채팅창 전체 ── */
	.embeddedServiceSidebar.modalContainer,
	#embedded-messaging {
		border-radius: 16px !important;
		overflow: hidden !important;
		box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(11,31,51,0.22) !important;
		width: 360px !important;
		max-height: 560px !important;
		bottom: 88px !important;
		right: 20px !important;
	}
	/* 채팅창 헤더 */
	.embedded-messaging-header {
		border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0 !important;
		background: #0b1f33 !important;
		padding: 14px 18px !important;
	}
	/* 메시지 말풍선 */
	.slds-chat-message__text_inbound.embedded-messaging-inbound-chat-message,
	.slds-chat-message__text_outbound.embedded-messaging-outbound-chat-message {
		max-width: 78% !important;
		font-size: 13.5px !important;
		line-height: 1.55 !important;
		border-radius: 12px !important;
		padding: 9px 13px !important;
	}
	.slds-chat-message__text_inbound.embedded-messaging-inbound-chat-message {
		margin-right: auto !important;
		background: #f0f2f5 !important;
		color: #1d1f20 !important;
	}
	.slds-chat-message__text_outbound.embedded-messaging-outbound-chat-message {
		margin-left: auto !important;
		background: #0b1f33 !important;
		color: #ffffff !important;
	}
	/* 에이전트 아바타 */
	lightning-avatar.embedded-messaging-chat-message-agent-avatar::part(avatar) {
		width: 30px !important;
		height: 30px !important;
		border-radius: 50% !important;
	}
	/* 시스템 메시지 */
	.embedded-messaging-system-event-participantchanged-text {
		background: transparent !important;
		padding: 2px 4px !important;
		font-size: 11.5px !important;
		color: #7f95a9 !important;
	}
	/* 기본 MIAW FAB 버튼 숨김 */
	.embeddedServiceHelpButton,
	.embedded-messaging-fab-button,
	#embedded-messaging-fab-container {
		display: none !important;
	}
	/* 쿨빗 커스텀 채팅 버튼 */
	#ot-chat-fab {
		position: fixed;
		bottom: 24px;
		right: 24px;
		width: 64px;
		height: 64px;
		border-radius: 50%;
		background: #0b1f33;
		border: none;
		cursor: pointer;
		box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(11,31,51,0.35);
		z-index: 9999;
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		transition: transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s;
		padding: 0;
		overflow: hidden;
	}
	#ot-chat-fab:hover {
		transform: scale(1.08);
		box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(22,184,200,0.4);
	}
	#ot-chat-fab img {
		width: 58px;
		height: 58px;
		object-fit: contain;
		mix-blend-mode: screen;
	}
</style>
<script>
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
		var fab = document.createElement('button');
		fab.id = 'ot-chat-fab';
		fab.setAttribute('aria-label', 'AI 상담 시작');
		var img = document.createElement('img');
		img.src = '/resource/OT_Coolbit_Monitor';
		img.alt = '쿨빗';
		fab.appendChild(img);
		fab.addEventListener('click', function() {
			document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ot_launch_chat', { detail: {} }));
		});
		document.body.appendChild(fab);
	});
</script>
